title: IRGC Claims It Has Downed 68 US MQ-1 and MQ-9 Drones in the Strait of Hormuz Area
text:
IRGC Claims It Has Downed 68 US MQ-1 and MQ-9 Drones in the Strait of Hormuz Area"

"Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) has released images said to show the interception and destruction of advanced US-made MQ-1 and MQ-9 drones over the Strait of Hormuz. The IRGC said the footage includes the interception and downing of one MQ-1 early on Thursday, 29 October, east of the Strait of Hormuz, off the coast of Sirik."

"According to the IRGC Public Relations Office, the MQ-1 downed that morning brings the total number of these two specific types of US drones destroyed by the IRGC Aerospace Force’s new advanced air defense system to 68 — including 54 MQ-9s and 14 MQ-1s."

"The IRGC said the system operates under Iran’s integrated air defense network and has been used against drones that it describes as among the United States’ valuable reconnaissance and combat assets. It said the significance of the claimed achievement is not only the number of drones destroyed, but also the ability to detect, track and destroy advanced targets under real combat conditions, a capability it says is the result of years of work by Iranian specialists and commanders in developing indigenous air defense."

"Source: IRGC Public Relations Office.
